title: HSK 3.19 · 传播, 收听, 否认, 消费
focus: 放到 · 静 · 需求 · 只好 · 传说 · 转变 · 至今 · 打破 · 制度 · 制定 · 据说 · 否认 · 传播 · 好奇 · 播放 · 突出 · 可靠 · 收费 · 难度 · 播出 · 消费 · 认可 · 传来 · 短期 · 学费 · 否定 · 认出 · 可乐 · 近期 · 将近 · 打听 · 定期 · 收看 · 听众 · 变为 · 预报 · 报到 · 认得 · 短裤 · 收听
body:
A media-and-money lesson: 播 "spread, sow" and 收 "receive" give you broadcasting and tuning in, 传 is passing things along, and 费 is every fee you pay. 认 "recognize" and 否 "no" pair up as admit vs deny.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 传 | chuán | pass on (亻 + 专 phonetic) | 传说, 传播, 传来 |
| 播 | bō | sow, spread; broadcast (扌 + 番 phonetic) | 传播, 播放, 播出 |
| 收 | shōu | receive, collect | 收费, 收看, 收听 |
| 认 | rèn | recognize, admit | 否认, 认可, 认出, 认得 |
| 费 | fèi | fee, spend (贝 money below) | 收费, 消费, 学费 |
| 期 | qī | period of time | 短期, 近期, 定期 |
| 否 | fǒu | no, not (不 over 口) | 否认, 否定 |
| 短 | duǎn | short | 短期, 短裤 |

## Watch out

- 好奇 is **hào**qí: 好 reads hào when it means "to like".
- 打听 and 认得 end light: dǎting, rènde.
- 否 (不 + 口) vs 杏 apricot (木 + 口).

cards.Example: 把书放到桌子上。 bǎ shū fàngdào zhuōzi shang: put the book on the table
cards.Notes: 放 put, release + 到 to, arrive = put it to (a place)

cards.Example: 晚上很静。 wǎnshang hěn jìng: it's quiet at night
cards.Notes: 静 = 青 qīng (gives the sound) + 争 struggle; as in 安静 quiet

cards.Example: 市场需求很大。 shìchǎng xūqiú hěn dà: market demand is high
cards.Notes: 需 need + 求 seek, request = demand

cards.Example: 没车了，只好走路。 méi chē le, zhǐhǎo zǒulù: no buses, so we had to walk
cards.Notes: 只 only + 好 good = the only good (option) is…

cards.Example: 这是一个传说。 zhè shì yí ge chuánshuō: this is a legend
cards.Notes: 传 pass on + 说 say = what's passed on by word of mouth

cards.Example: 他的态度转变了。 tā de tàidu zhuǎnbiàn le: his attitude changed
cards.Notes: 转 turn (车 wheel + 专 phonetic) + 变 change = turn and change

cards.Example: 他至今没回来。 tā zhìjīn méi huílai: he still hasn't come back
cards.Notes: 至 reach, until + 今 now = up till now

cards.Example: 他打破了纪录。 tā dǎpò le jìlù: he broke the record
cards.Notes: 打 hit + 破 break (石 stone + 皮 pí phonetic) = break open

cards.Example: 公司有新制度。 gōngsī yǒu xīn zhìdù: the company has a new system
cards.Notes: 制 regulate, make + 度 measure, rule = a set of rules

cards.Example: 我们制定了计划。 wǒmen zhìdìng le jìhuà: we drew up a plan
cards.Notes: 制 make + 定 fix, settle = make and fix (plans, rules)

cards.Example: 据说他要结婚了。 jùshuō tā yào jiéhūn le: they say he's getting married
cards.Notes: 据 according to (扌 + 居 jū phonetic) + 说 say = according to what's said

cards.Example: 他否认了这件事。 tā fǒurèn le zhè jiàn shì: he denied it
cards.Notes: 否 no + 认 admit = say no to admitting, deny

cards.Example: 消息传播得很快。 xiāoxi chuánbō de hěn kuài: news spreads fast
cards.Notes: 传 pass on + 播 sow, scatter = spread around

cards.Example: 孩子很好奇。 háizi hěn hàoqí: kids are curious
cards.Notes: 好 hào like + 奇 strange = liking strange things, curious

cards.Example: 现在播放新闻。 xiànzài bōfàng xīnwén: now playing the news
cards.Notes: 播 broadcast + 放 release, play = play (a show, video)

cards.Example: 他的成绩很突出。 tā de chéngjì hěn tūchū: his results stand out
cards.Notes: 突 burst out (穴 hole + 犬 dog) + 出 out = stick out

cards.Example: 他这个人很可靠。 tā zhège rén hěn kěkào: he's reliable
cards.Notes: 可 can + 靠 lean on = can be leaned on

cards.Example: 这里停车收费吗？ zhèlǐ tíngchē shōufèi ma: is parking paid here?
cards.Notes: 收 collect + 费 fee = charge

cards.Example: 这题难度很大。 zhè tí nándù hěn dà: this question is very hard
cards.Notes: 难 difficult + 度 degree = degree of difficulty

cards.Example: 节目八点播出。 jiémù bā diǎn bōchū: the show airs at eight
cards.Notes: 播 broadcast + 出 out = send out on air

cards.Example: 年轻人消费很多。 niánqīngrén xiāofèi hěn duō: young people spend a lot
cards.Notes: 消 use up, vanish + 费 spend = consume

cards.Example: 大家都认可他。 dàjiā dōu rènkě tā: everyone acknowledges him
cards.Notes: 认 recognize + 可 approve, OK = accept as good

cards.Example: 外面传来歌声。 wàimiàn chuánlái gēshēng: singing came from outside
cards.Notes: 传 pass + 来 come = be carried over here

cards.Example: 这是短期工作。 zhè shì duǎnqī gōngzuò: this is a short-term job
cards.Notes: 短 short + 期 period = short period

cards.Example: 学费很贵。 xuéfèi hěn guì: tuition is expensive
cards.Notes: 学 study + 费 fee = tuition

cards.Example: 他否定了我的想法。 tā fǒudìng le wǒ de xiǎngfǎ: he rejected my idea
cards.Notes: 否 no + 定 settle = settle on 'no', negate

cards.Example: 我没认出你。 wǒ méi rènchū nǐ: I didn't recognize you
cards.Notes: 认 recognize + 出 out = pick out and recognize

cards.Example: 我要一杯可乐。 wǒ yào yì bēi kělè: I'd like a cola
cards.Notes: 可 + 乐 chosen for the sound of 'cola' (and meaning 'can be happy')

cards.Example: 近期天气很好。 jìnqī tiānqì hěn hǎo: the weather's been good lately
cards.Notes: 近 near + 期 period = near-term

cards.Example: 将近十点了。 jiāngjìn shí diǎn le: it's nearly ten
cards.Notes: 将 about to + 近 near = getting close to

cards.Example: 我去打听一下。 wǒ qù dǎting yíxià: I'll ask around
cards.Notes: 打 do (general verb) + 听 listen = go listening for news

cards.Example: 要定期检查身体。 yào dìngqī jiǎnchá shēntǐ: get regular checkups
cards.Notes: 定 fixed + 期 period = at fixed intervals

cards.Example: 欢迎收看新闻。 huānyíng shōukàn xīnwén: welcome to the news
cards.Notes: 收 receive + 看 watch = tune in and watch

cards.Example: 听众都笑了。 tīngzhòng dōu xiào le: the audience laughed
cards.Notes: 听 listen + 众 crowd (three 人) = listening crowd

cards.Example: 水变为冰。 shuǐ biànwéi bīng: water turns into ice
cards.Notes: 变 change + 为 wéi into = become

cards.Example: 天气预报说下雨。 tiānqì yùbào shuō xià yǔ: the forecast says rain
cards.Notes: 预 in advance + 报 report = forecast

cards.Example: 新生明天报到。 xīnshēng míngtiān bàodào: new students register tomorrow
cards.Notes: 报 report + 到 arrive = report your arrival

cards.Example: 你还认得我吗？ nǐ hái rènde wǒ ma: do you still recognize me?
cards.Notes: 认 recognize + 得 (neutral, attains) = know on sight

cards.Example: 夏天穿短裤。 xiàtiān chuān duǎnkù: wear shorts in summer
cards.Notes: 短 short + 裤 pants (衤 clothing + 库 kù for sound)

cards.Example: 我每天收听广播。 wǒ měitiān shōutīng guǎngbō: I listen to the radio daily
cards.Notes: 收 receive + 听 listen = tune in
